source_name: ECB – Vracanie bankoviek do obehu (banknote recycling, SK-language page)
why_relevant: Defines the 'ostatní spracovatelia peňazí' category (CIT firms, retailers, casinos recycling banknotes via ATMs) and points to the national frameworks and NHTO/CRS arrangements that govern SK cash-cycle operators.

source_name: NBS – Registre dohliadaných subjektov (subjekty.nbs.sk)
why_relevant: Entity register to resolve and enumerate supervised/licensed players; the route to confirm which cash-processing and payment entities hold NBS authorisations referenced by Loomis and others.

source_name: Bitcoinmat.sk – crypto ATM operator (SK/CZ)
why_relevant: Self-described largest Bitcoin-ATM deployer in SK/CZ; a non-bank cash-accepting device fleet that competes for the same cash-access footprint and publishes machine locations.

source_name: Kvakomat – crypto ATM network map for Slovakia
why_relevant: Second SK crypto-ATM network with a public country map; together with Bitcoinmat gives a countable non-bank cash-in device layer.

source_name: openiazoch.zoznam.sk – Mastercard/Visa survey coverage
why_relevant: Long-running SK personal-finance portal that reprints scheme survey findings with figures; provides historical depth for time-series of scheme survey claims.

source_name: Electronic Payments International – Slovakia country surveys
why_relevant: Trade-press country survey combining scheme and central-bank figures (contactless card share, POS contactless acceptance, mobile payment volumes) — a convenient triangulation layer for SK card/cash metrics.

source_name: subjekty.nbs.sk – PSD2 register JSON API (open data endpoint)
why_relevant: Machine-readable daily-updated JSON of every SK PSD2 provider with per-service start/end dates — directly yields a market-entry/exit time series, i.e. a market-structure statistic, not just a list.

source_name: NBS – Platobné služby a elektronické peniaze (supervision landing + sub-lists)
why_relevant: Curated NBS hub linking the separate lists: payment institutions and AISP, electronic money institutions, and entities operating under the limited-network/exception regime — the last is the only public view of unlicensed-but-active payment actors.

source_name: NBS – Registre (master index of all NBS registers)
why_relevant: Single index page enumerating every NBS register (PSD2, RBUZ, creditors, financial agents, CERI, AIF managers). Best snowball surface for discovering registers this cell has not yet mapped.

source_name: NBS – Register veriteľov (regver.nbs.sk, consumer-credit creditors register)
why_relevant: Lists licensed consumer-credit providers — the non-bank lending layer that increasingly issues cards/BNPL; entry/exit dates give a market-structure series adjacent to card statistics.

source_name: NBS – Register finančných agentov a finančných poradcov (regfap.nbs.sk)
why_relevant: Statutory register of financial intermediaries/advisors including the distribution layer for banking products; useful for mapping distribution networks and counting active intermediary firms.

source_name: NBS – Dohľad nad kryptoaktívami / MiCA CASP licensing pages
why_relevant: NBS became the SK MiCA supervisor; its licensing pages and news items date CASP authorisations (e.g. a published count of licensed providers). New-entrant dating for the crypto-payments adjacency.

source_name: NBS – Zoznam účastníkov platobného systému SIPS
why_relevant: Definitive list of direct participants in the domestic SIPS payment system — identifies which institutions actually clear SK retail payments, a narrower and more meaningful set than the licence register.

source_name: EBA – Register of payment and electronic money institutions under PSD2 (filter: SK)
why_relevant: EU-wide central register, downloadable in bulk and updated at least daily by NCAs; the only single surface that shows both SK-authorised institutions AND inbound passporting into SK — cross-border competitive pressure that the NBS list alone understates.

source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (credit institutions register hub)
why_relevant: Hub for the EBA credit institutions register and other 'other lists' (e.g. exempted entities, crowdfunding); lets the SK bank/acquirer universe be reconciled against an EU-consistent identifier set.

source_name: ECB – Lists of financial institutions (MFI list, Slovakia subset)
why_relevant: Daily-updated MFI list with CSV download; gives the statistically-defined population of SK monetary financial institutions, which is the denominator behind ECB/NBS banking and payment statistics.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities (SSM), Slovakia section
why_relevant: Periodic PDF listing significant and less-significant SK institutions with LEIs and group affiliation — resolves which SK banks are subsidiaries of foreign groups, key for interpreting acquiring/issuing market shares.

source_name: Register právnických osôb, podnikateľov a orgánov verejnej moci (RPO) – Štatistický úrad SR
why_relevant: Unified reference register consolidating 70+ source registers; carries SK NACE activity codes, so it can enumerate all entities classified under payment/financial-service activities — a population frame no single licence list provides.

source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS)
why_relevant: Anti-corruption register of ultimate beneficial owners for any firm receiving public money — the only public surface exposing UBO chains behind SK payment/IT vendors serving state banks and public tenders.

source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) + Open API
why_relevant: Statutory financial-statements register with a documented open API and weekly SQL dumps. Turns any register-derived entity list into revenue/asset time series — the mechanism that converts a pointer cell into quantitative market-share estimates for acquirers, PIs and fintechs.

source_name: Ekosystém Slovensko.Digital – otvorené dáta a API (ORSR/RPO/RÚZ/Obchodný vestník mirrors)
why_relevant: Consolidated API layer over ORSR, RPO, RÚZ, Central Contract Register and Obchodný vestník — practically the only sane bulk route into SK company data, since ORSR itself has no API.

source_name: Obchodný vestník SR (Commercial Bulletin, Ministry of Justice)
why_relevant: Official daily gazette publishing incorporations, capital changes, mergers, liquidations and insolvencies — the earliest dated public signal of market entry/exit and consolidation among SK payment and fintech firms.

source_name: NBS – Zoznam registrov údajov o spotrebiteľských úveroch (list of consumer-credit data registries)
why_relevant: Names the private credit bureaus (e.g. bank and non-bank registers) operating in SK — each of which is itself a holder of aggregate lending/card statistics and a potential commercial data source.

source_name: NBS – Centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií (CERI)
why_relevant: Central store of regulated disclosures by SK listed issuers, including listed banks — routes to annual/interim reports containing card, ATM and acquiring volumes that are not in statistical releases.

source_name: e-Justice EU – Business registers in Slovakia (country page)
why_relevant: EU-maintained explainer of which SK registers exist, who runs them, what they legally contain and how to search them — an authoritative meta-source for validating the register map and its coverage limits.

source_name: Citium Tech – EU PSD2 Register mirror (Slovakia filter)
why_relevant: Third-party reformatting of the EBA PSD2 register with country filters and counts (e.g. an SK authorised-PI count). Useful as a fast cross-check and for spotting register changes, never as the citation of record.
